title: Membership Policy
description: Membership expectations and participation in the MSAK student fellowship.

sections.heading: 1. Who May Join
paragraphs: The portal is intended for students who wish to connect with the Messianic Students Association of Kenya. Members should provide an institution and study information that accurately describes their current circumstances.

sections.heading: 2. Registration
paragraphs: Complete the registration form using your own contact details. Select the MSAK association, county and institution that best match your place of study. Keep your contact and academic details current.

sections.heading: 3. Participation
paragraphs: Members are encouraged to take part in fellowship, learning, outreach and service in ways that suit their circumstances. Participation should follow the Community Standards and any applicable institutional requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Membership and Portal Access
paragraphs: A portal account provides access to member features but does not itself appoint a person to office or grant publishing privileges. Some information and announcements are available only to signed-in members or their intended audience.

sections.heading: 5. Questions and Changes
paragraphs: For help with membership information or to raise a concern, contact your institutional or regional MSAK leadership. MSAK may revise this policy as membership structures develop.
